text: why dont you just move it all to the gpu instead? i mean look at @cart/boxxx_demo.tsx for example
resolution: Verified the user's GPU instinct against the engine and wrote §12.1 of the structure review (commit eaf1a0881), superseding §12's React-capture compositing plan. paintRectBatch (engine.zig:2420) already has a FLAT-SPEC path — boxes as pure 14-float data rows, no nodes, no layout, straight into the instanced SDF-rect pipeline (gpu/rects.zig) — and a DecalRectNode is exactly one such row; decal.ts is already data-only, so DecalDoc → instance rows is a direct serialization with no JSX walk. Revised merged-painter plan: mask layers stay on GPU paintables, node layers lower to instanced rows, z-order = draw order between two GPU pipelines; StaticSurface capture leaves the edit loop entirely (also removing the per-keystroke compose re-bake and the editor's dependency on the suspected /test-lag mechanism). Real dependency list: glyph-atlas emit (the already-named Boxxx next layer — building it unblocks Boxxx v2 for every cart), textured-quad instances for images, frozen shader fills baked once to content-addressed textures (V29), selection chrome stays React. Materialize = one GPU readback via the existing capture.zig.
